title: Check a total
purpose: Check whether the sum of two item amounts is within the supplied budget, and explain the evidence and limitations.
inputsDescription: Text describing exactly two item amounts, plus a separate budget expressed as a decimal string.
resultDescription: A prose report based on the original text, exact arithmetic and model advice. This flow does not purchase anything. Correct arithmetic does not establish that the model selected the right amounts.

phases.title: Calculate and compare
phases.description: The coder selects two amounts and calls the local calculator. A second task compares that saved sum with the user's budget using runtime-bound arguments.

phases.title: Review the evidence
phases.description: The tool-free reasoner receives the original text and both calculator results and provides advice in prose.

phases.title: Explain the result
phases.description: The coder prepares the final report. Success means the declared output checks passed; the runtime does not prove the accuracy of the prose.
